description: This is a unit test source file for the SugarBean class and related components within the SuiteCRM project. It contains numerous test cases for methods like constructor, field definitions, relationship handling, and database interactions related to SugarBeans.

classes.name: SugarBeanTest
classes.description: The test class extends SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase and includes multiple test methods for the SugarBean class functionalities.

classes.name: SugarBeanTest
classes.description: This test class extends SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase and includes numerous test methods for validating the functionalities of the SugarBean class, including relationship handling, field definitions, data formatting, encryption, audit management, and save operations.
